topic: Do your customers actually read your Instagram captions?

hooks.text: Business owners: Are your Instagram captions being ignored?
3 reasons your captions get zero clicks.
Mistake: Hiding offers in long captions kills sales.

replies.reply: Packages are INR 999, 1,499, and 2,199, and you pay only after you approve the work. Quick question: what kind of business do you run, and what offer do you want to highlight?

replies.if_they_say: Do you make these for my kind of business?
replies.reply: I make them for all types of local businesses, from clinics and cafes to gyms and retail shops. What do you sell, and what is the main message you want customers to notice?

replies.if_they_say: Can a short video really explain my whole service?
replies.reply: A short ad works best when it highlights just one specific offer or hook rather than everything. It gets attention so people reach out. What is your most popular service or product right now?
